title: Core LangChain Base Components
summary: This module defines the foundational abstract base classes and interfaces for core LangChain components. It covers serialization, composable units of work (Runnables), language models, prompt templates, output parsers, tools, retrievers, document loaders, vector stores, and memory systems.

nodes.label: Serializable
nodes.title: Base for JSON Serialization
nodes.description: Provides core methods and properties for objects to be serialized to and deserialized from JSON, managing namespaces, secrets, and attributes.

nodes.label: Runnable
nodes.title: Composable Unit of Work
nodes.description: An abstract interface for units of work that can be invoked, batched, streamed, transformed, and composed into chains, supporting configuration and tracing.

nodes.label: RunnableSerializable
nodes.title: Serializable Composable Unit
nodes.description: Combines serialization capabilities with the Runnable interface, enabling persistent and configurable units of work within LangChain.

nodes.label: RunnableEachBase
nodes.title: Apply Runnable to Each Item
nodes.description: A Runnable that applies an encapsulated Runnable to each element of an input list, returning a list of results.

nodes.label: RunnableBindingBase
nodes.title: Bind Args/Config to Runnable
nodes.description: A Runnable that wraps another Runnable, allowing specific arguments or configuration to be bound and passed during its execution.

nodes.label: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.title: Abstract Language Model Interface
nodes.description: Defines the foundational interface for all language models, including methods for text generation, prompt handling, caching, and token management.

nodes.label: SimpleChatModel
nodes.title: Simplified Chat Model
nodes.description: A simplified abstract base class for implementing chat models, primarily for backward compatibility with a basic _call method.

nodes.label: LLM
nodes.title: Simple LLM Interface
nodes.description: Provides a straightforward interface for creating custom Large Language Models, requiring implementation of core generation logic and identification parameters.

nodes.label: BasePromptTemplate
nodes.title: Base Prompt Template
nodes.description: The abstract base class for all prompt templates, managing input variables, partial variables, and formatting into PromptValue objects for language models.

nodes.label: BaseGenerationOutputParser
nodes.title: Parse LLM Generations
nodes.description: An abstract base class for parsing the raw output (Generation objects) from language model calls into a desired structured format.

nodes.label: BaseOutputParser
nodes.title: Parse LLM Output
nodes.description: An abstract base class for parsing the output of an LLM call (either string or message) into a structured format.

nodes.label: BaseTool
nodes.title: Base Tool Interface
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for all LangChain tools, which are actionable components that agents can utilize to perform specific tasks.

nodes.label: BaseRetriever
nodes.title: Abstract Document Retriever
nodes.description: The abstract base class for document retrieval systems, providing an interface to fetch relevant documents based on a given query.

nodes.label: BaseLoader
nodes.title: Base Document Loader
nodes.description: An abstract interface for loading raw data into Document objects, supporting both immediate and lazy loading, and document splitting.

nodes.label: VectorStore
nodes.title: Vector Database Interface
nodes.description: Defines the interface for vector databases, enabling operations like adding, deleting, and searching for documents based on vector embeddings.

nodes.label: DocumentIndex
nodes.title: Indexable Document Retriever
nodes.description: A specialized document retriever that extends BaseRetriever with indexing capabilities, including upserting, deleting, and retrieving documents by ID.

nodes.label: BaseMemory
nodes.title: Abstract Memory Component
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for memory components in LangChain Chains, used to store and inject conversational or state information.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Fundamental Building Blocks
groups.description: These components define the most fundamental interfaces for serialization and composable units of work in LangChain.

groups.label: Runnable Implementations
groups.title: Specialized Runnable Behaviors
groups.description: These classes provide specific implementations or modifications for the core Runnable interface, such as batch processing or argument binding.

groups.label: Language Model Interfaces
groups.title: Abstract Language Model Definitions
groups.description: These components define the abstract interfaces for interacting with various types of language models, including general LLMs and chat-specific models.

groups.label: Prompting
groups.title: Prompt Template Management
groups.description: This component provides the base for creating and managing prompt templates, handling variable substitution and formatting for language model inputs.

groups.label: Output Parsing
groups.title: Structured Output Extraction
groups.description: These classes define how to parse and structure the raw text or message outputs generated by language models into usable formats.

groups.label: Tools
groups.title: Actionable Agent Components
groups.description: This component defines the base interface for tools, which are external functionalities or actions that LangChain agents can invoke.

groups.label: Retrieval & Storage Interfaces
groups.title: Document Management and Search
groups.description: These interfaces define how documents are loaded, stored in vector databases, and retrieved based on queries or IDs.

groups.label: Memory
groups.title: Conversational State Management
groups.description: This abstract class provides the foundation for memory components that store and manage conversational history or other state within LangChain Chains.
